task.title: Work with Worktrees
task.shortdesc: Open an existing Git worktree as a working copy in the Git Staging view.

context.p: A worktree is an additional working copy of a repository checked out to its own folder. The Git Client treats worktrees like any other working copy.

step.cmd: Open the worktree's folder as a working copy, the same way you open any repository.

result.note: The Git Client cannot create worktrees. Create them from a terminal with the git worktree command, then open them from the Git Staging view.
